question: Display the qualified four-group MCU and within-cohort week-16 transplant comparisons.
decision: Present existing values with scale, cohort and source-row sensitivity.
strongest_rival: Unknown donor or preparation overlap, gating composition, shared normalization and protocol differences can obscure endpoint-specific differences.
discriminator: Show all four shRNA genotype groups and separate donor cohorts with their original row totals.
exposure_record: All original Song S2 and S4 values and effects were read before this rendering-only freeze.
biological_unit: Source observations from the verified S2 and S4 runs. Preparation and donor linkage remain unresolved.
nesting_and_overlap: Panel-local workbook labels and library numbers are not donor crosswalks. No paired, clustered or cross-age inference.
population_and_selection: Plan-defined mouse assays and deposited contexts in Song et al., DOI 10.1038/s43587-024-00670-8.
contrast: Previously recorded arm means and within-cohort KO minus WT contrasts.
endpoint: Previously recorded Rhod-2, TMRM, recovered HSC count, colony count and week-16 PB donor percentage.
methods: Render existing source observations, group means, contrast estimates and leave-one-row ranges. No biological recalculation or tests.
missingness_and_exclusions: Preserve source blanks and named arm rows; separate columns containing figure summaries. No imputation or selection to match the legend.
multiplicity: Descriptive effects only; no new significance, equivalence or genome-wide discovery testing.
precision_basis: Limits of row sensitivity retained; donor-level precision unavailable from unlinked source labels.
interpretation_limit: Same-source reanalysis. No biological replication, independent preparation assumptions, mediator attribution or unobserved factorial cell.
stop_rule: Stop on missing expected panels or mismatch between plotted row counts and recorded arm counts.
amendment_reason: Initial rendering-only contract using existing verified outputs.
